Note: replacing the old nvm-backed tree removed previous global npm CLI symlinks from the mise node bin; reinstall intentionally needed CLIs via mise npm backend or npm install -g under mise.

title: Upgrade VPS runtimes, then raise the shared mise baseline
description: 00-shared.toml keeps the VPS baseline (hk 1.51.0, bun 1.3.14, node 24, python 3.13, ruby 3.4); this Mac overrides to hk 2, bun 1.4, node 26, python 3.15 in host.toml. On the VPS: install the new versions, check its services (node 24 to 26 is a major jump), then raise 00-shared.toml, update tests/mise_host_config_check.py and ADR-020, and drop Mac overrides that match. Start with hk 2: hk 2.9.0 validates the current hk.pkl on the Mac.

title: Auto-invoke beads-slim when bd is set up in a new project
description: Currently beads-slim (dot_scripts/executable_beads-slim) has to be run manually against a repo after bd init/bd setup. Idea from a falai session: teach agents (via global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md or the beads skill) to run beads-slim automatically whenever they initialize bd in a project, so new projects get the trimmed PRIME.md + tuned hooks without a manual step. No code needed beyond the existing script -- this is a global-instructions change, not new tooling. Deferred because it touches ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (global, affects every project) and needs its own consideration separate from the beads-slim script itself.
